Name: OVERLAY_MATERIAL_PARAM_ST
Description: Overlay materials added to characters through SpEffectVfxParam (up to four at once).

Fields.Name: Overlay Material Name
Fields.Description: Overlay material name (up to 31 characters); no reader found. Retail: C_Ov_ names such as C_Ov_Night_Scale01, C_Ov[c7500]_Burn, C_Ov_PalyerDead.

Fields.Name: Material ID
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 10 (27 rows), 100 (the Night/Chaos scale overlays), 11, 20, 90, 0 on the test row.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value 0
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value 1
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 1 on every row except C_Ov_TempleGhost (0.5).
